question: 跟2026年一季报相比，二季报前十大有什么换仓动作？新进了谁、又剔出了谁？
answer:
[1] 关键金融指标  
- 前十大股东名单
- 股东持股数量/比例
- 新进股东名单
- 剔除股东名单

[2] 可能的计算公式  
- 新进股东 = 二季报前十大股东名单 - 一季报前十大股东名单  
- 剔除股东 = 一季报前十大股东名单 - 二季报前十大股东名单  
- 换仓动作 = 新进股东 + 剔除股东  
- 变化持股数量 = 二季报持股数量 - 一季报持股数量（对比相同股东）

SELECT 
    t1.A_STOCKSNAME AS `股票简称`,
    t1.A_STOCKCODE AS `股票代码`,
    t1.ENDDATE AS `2026年一季报发布日期`,
    t1.`RANK` AS `2026年一季报股东名次`,
    t1.NAME AS `2026年一季报股东名称`,
    ROUND(t1.HOLD_PCT, 2) AS `2026年一季报持股比例(%)`,
    t2.ENDDATE AS `2026年二季报发布日期`,
    t2.`RANK` AS `2026年二季报股东名次`,
    t2.NAME AS `2026年二季报股东名称`,
    ROUND(t2.HOLD_PCT, 2) AS `2026年二季报持股比例(%)`,
    CASE
        WHEN t1.NAME IS NULL AND t2.NAME IS NOT NULL THEN '新进'
        WHEN t1.NAME IS NOT NULL AND t2.NAME IS NULL THEN '剔出'
        WHEN t1.NAME IS NOT NULL AND t2.NAME IS NOT NULL AND t1.HOLD_PCT <> t2.HOLD_PCT THEN '持仓变动'
        ELSE '无变化'
    END AS `变动类型`
FROM
    (SELECT 
        A_STOCKCODE, A_STOCKSNAME, ENDDATE, `RANK`, NAME, HOLD_PCT
     FROM GET_STK_SHR_CLS_DTL
     WHERE ENDDATE = '2026-03-31'
       AND ISVALID = 1
       AND NAME IS NOT NULL
       AND `RANK` <= 10
    ) t1
FULL JOIN
    (SELECT 
        A_STOCKCODE, A_STOCKSNAME, ENDDATE, `RANK`, NAME, HOLD_PCT
     FROM GET_STK_SHR_CLS_DTL
     WHERE ENDDATE = '2026-06-30'
       AND ISVALID = 1
       AND NAME IS NOT NULL
       AND `RANK` <= 10
    ) t2
ON t1.A_STOCKCODE = t2.A_STOCKCODE AND t1.NAME = t2.NAME
WHERE 
    (t1.NAME IS NULL OR t2.NAME IS NULL OR t1.HOLD_PCT <> t2.HOLD_PCT)
ORDER BY 
    t2.A_STOCKCODE, `变动类型` DESC
